title: The Arcane Archivist
description: An elderly woman with white hair in a bun stands in a dimly lit study, wearing a dark blue robe with silver trim. She holds a glowing vial in her right hand while examining scrolls and documents spread across a large wooden desk surrounded by candles.
prompt: An elderly female scholar with white hair tied in a neat bun stands in a dark blue mystical study filled with floating candles hanging from the ceiling. She wears a long dark blue robe with intricate silver trim and holds up a glowing vial, examining it closely. A large wooden desk in front of her is covered with ancient scrolls, framed documents, and more lit candles. Bookshelves line the walls, a large painting of a butterfly hangs behind her, and the entire scene is illuminated by warm candlelight creating a mysterious atmosphere.
